description: Screen UK phone numbers against the TPS and CTPS registers before calling. Each result is clean, tps-listed, ctps-listed, unknown, suppressed or consented. Draws the account's prepaid UK credits, one per distinct valid number; a test API key (tpsc_test_) returns fixtures at no cost. Same as POST /v1/screen.

campaign_ref.description: Optional reference stored on the audit record: letters, digits, spaces and . , : / # _ - only.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers, up to 1,000 per call, for example "+447700900123".

name: screen_numbers
title: Screen UK numbers (TPS and CTPS)
